rows.text:
Initial 3 Villagers:
1st builds Monument next to hunt
2nd builds Granary in the middle of hunt group
3rd gathers food first and then helps with Granary if not yet finished
rows.note:
Pharoah empowers monument and then Granary
Priest scouts the map and builds Obelisks

rows.text: 1 Villager goes to strangler tree, cut 8 wood, then build Mining Camp and goes to Gold
4 Villagers to Gold (first villager helps build the Mining Camp if needed)
rows.note:
Research Flood of the Nile tech at the Granary
Research Pickaxe tech at the Mining Camp

At 150 gold, 2 of the Gold Vills build a Temple
After the Temple, 1 of the Temple builders builds Houses, the other returns to Gold
Research Hands of the Pharoah at the Temple

rows.text: Transfer all but 3 food Villagers and Pharoah to gold
Send 8 Villagers, Pharoah, Priest and Myth Unit to build and secure your 2nd TC
